question: For the variables X, Y and Z, rₓy = 0.80, rₓz = 0.64, and ryz = 0.79, the square of multiple correlation coefficient mathop Rnolimitsₓyz² is:
solution:
The square of the multiple correlation coefficient is **0.64.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **multiple correlation coefficient (R)** is a statistic that measures the strength of the relationship between multiple independent variables and a dependent variable.
 
• The s**quare of the multiple correlation coefficient (R²) **is a measure of the proportion of variation in the dependent variable that is explained by the independent variables.
 
• The formula for R²ₓyz in terms of the pairwise correlations r_xy, r_yz , r_zx given by R²ₓyz = frac{rₓy² + rₓz² - 2rₓy rₓz ryz}{1 - ryz²}

 
• rₓy = 0.80, rₓz = 0.64, and ryz = 0.79
 
• By putting the value of above variable in the equation. 
 
• the square of the multiple correlation coefficient R²ₓyz = 
 is approximately: 0.6386 or 0.64

 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ​ **Additional Information__**

 
• In this case, the square of the multiple correlation coefficient of 0.64 means that 64% of the variation in the dependent variable can be explained by the combination of the independent variables X, Y, and Z.
